root_cause: The new iterator-index fast path assumes Object.keys iteration has no surprising prototype side effects, while the existing iterator cache and enumeration path do not enforce an own-properties-only iterator.
findings: This newly added LoadIteratorElement branch lets Object.keys iteration use the iterator-indices optimization. For property loads it emits an indexed slot access based on the iterator's cached indices. The earlier iterator cache path can still enumerate/reuse prototype properties, including a Proxy trap that runs script.
